The following events took place in '''4009 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Systino]] crime syndicate discovers the planet [[244Core|Sraato]], a world rich in valuable natural resources. The Systino syndicate dominates most of the criminal activity in the sector for the next two hundred years.<ref name="Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
*[[Zythmnr]] goes into solitude on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4">Zythmnr had spent twelve years in exile before the events of [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]], which takes place in 3,997 BBY.</ref>
